tier_definition: analytic closed-form ICC.1:2022 math, IEEE-754 binary64, no colour management module

provenance.arithmetic: fractions.Fraction for colorant derivation; float (binary64) for transfer curves
references: ICC.1:2022-05 (v4.4) section 10.19 curveType, 10.18 parametricCurveType, 6.3 PCS Lab/XYZ, 9.2.* matrix/TRC model
Adobe RGB (1998) specification: primaries (0.64,0.33)(0.21,0.71)(0.15,0.06), D65, gamma 563/256

xyz_identity.note: colorants = identity, linear: device values ARE PCS XYZ

prophoto_para3.note: ProPhoto primaries (D50 native), sRGB type-3 curve

p3_para3.note: Display P3 primaries (Bradford D50, negative red Z), sRGB type-3 curve

srgb_curv_table1024.note: sRGB colorants, 1024-entry curv table of the IEC 61966-2-1 decode

srgb_para4.note: sRGB colorants, parametric type 4 with e,f offsets

srgb_curv_table.note: sRGB colorants, 33-entry curv table of x^2.4 (linear interpolation)

tolerance_basis: a priori: one 16-bit code value (1/65535). Budget: f32 pipeline (eps 6e-8) times at most 13x (sRGB encode slope) plus the engine's transfer-curve representation. Expected values use the decoded s15Fixed16 profile values, so profile fixed-point rounding is NOT part of the budget
